title: Atelier - The Exclusive Limited Edition Range Of Washbasins
bodyHtml:
Meet Ritual - The first washbasins from our Collection Atelier

Unique Designs, Uniquely Crafted

Collection Atelier is Studio Bagno’s most exclusive collection. The Ritual washbasin is the first from a series in which artists meticulously hand paint or apply decals to achieve natural and industrial textures that are extremely difficult to execute. Each creation is a risky and uncertain exercise whereby, subsequent to the firing process, leaves its hesitant and inevitable trace. The result is a fine porcelain piece that is truly a one-of-a-kind work of art. Tap it's fine rimmed edge to hear it sing.

Hand Made by Artisans

An old ceramic decoration workshop has been reborn. This Atelier breathes creativity into the now bustling space; the smell of paint, the heat of the kiln, the incessant swishing of paintbrushes on the sinuous forms of the washbasins, and of course, the murmur of the artists, carefully creating each unique piece of art. Collection Atelier Basins are each assigned a number creating a truly limited edition series.
